units.source_text: ……她们白天在修善寺，今天晚上来到汤岛，明天可能越过天城岭南行去汤野温泉。

en.t: ...They had been at Shuzenji during the day, would come to Yushima tonight, and tomorrow might cross Amagi Pass and head south to Yuno Onsen.

units.source_text: 在天城山二十多公里的山路上，一定可以追上她们。

en.t: On the mountain road of more than twenty kilometers through Mount Amagi, I would surely be able to catch up with them.

units.source_text: 我就是这样浮想联翩，急匆匆地赶来的。

en.t: With such thoughts racing through my mind, I had hurried all the way here.

units.source_text: 赶上避雨，我们在茶馆里相遇了。

en.t: Just as I stopped to take shelter from the rain, we met in the teahouse.
